def convert_to_excel_time(value):
    """Convert common race time text/numeric/datetime values to an Excel time fraction."""
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, timedelta):
        return value.total_seconds() / 86400
    # openpyxl can return datetime.time for time cells
    if hasattr(value, 'hour') and hasattr(value, 'minute') and hasattr(value, 'second') and not isinstance(value, str):
        return (value.hour * 3600 + value.minute * 60 + value.second) / 86400
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):

    else:
